clauses.original_operative_text:
(d) Within 45 days of the date of this order, the Secretary shall provide 
an interim report to the President, through the Director of the Office of 
Management and Budget, the Assistant to the President for Economic Policy, 
the Assistant to the President for Domestic Policy, and the Chairman of 
the Council on Environmental Quality, summarizing the findings of the 
review described in subsection (a) of this section with respect to Proclamation 
9558 of December 28, 2016 (Establishment of the Bears Ears National Monu-
ment), and such other designations as the Secretary determines to be appro-
priate for inclusion in the interim report. For those designations, the interim 
report shall include recommendations for such Presidential actions, legisla-
tive proposals, or other actions consistent with law as the Secretary may 
consider appropriate to carry out the policy set forth in section 1 of this 
order.

prior_first_end.assertion_status: prior canonical claim content; not a new finding or replacement date
prior_first_end.mechanism: express revocation by EO 13990 sec. 7(a) ('Executive Order 13792 of April 26, 2017 (Review of Designations Under the Antiquities Act) ... [is] hereby revoked'); EO 13990 states no effective date and no delayed-effect wording, so the revocation took effect on signing, January 20, 2021 (printed 86 FR 7041-7042, January 25, 2021)

clauses.prior_judgment_reason: Sec. 2(d): within 45 days the Secretary gives the President an interim report on the review, covering Proclamation 9558 (Bears Ears) and any other designations the Secretary chooses, with recommendations. The time period in this clause is a report or action deadline, not an end: the order has no wording that terminates the clause when the report or action is done, and a performed command stays part of the order until it is revoked (AGENT_PROTOCOL step 3; BATCH.md). The producer does not claim the date any report was delivered; that date is not an end-date source. First end = EO 13990 sec. 7(a) revocation, effective on signing, 2021-01-20.
clauses.required_scope_review: Obtain the interim-report transmittal and establish recipient, scope and date; the DOI testimony establishes submission by January 30, 2018, not an exact delivery date.

finding: The categorical claim that actual report delivery cannot be an end-date source excludes material evidence before examining it. The two report commands may have been performed well before the formal revocation asserted by the claim. Their exact first-cessation dates and legal effects remain unresolved; report completion does not automatically end sections 1, 2(a)-(c), or the entire order.
limitations: All five original EOs were read in their held extracted-text representation. Original PDF pages were not visually inspected in this audit; source locations remain subject to page verification.
Only the explicitly listed pages of the two newly acquired PDFs were visually inspected. No claim to a complete page-image reading is made.
No exact completion date is inferred from a deadline, publication bound or a later revocation.
No agency-specific completion/exemption/nonperformance fact is inferred from silence in a by-number EO search.
This is a targeted audit of one material premise and related source contradictions, not certification of every clause, later event, savings state or current predicate.
